_meta.purpose: Synthetic ICU registered nurse candidate; Denver CO, onsite or hybrid-style, no remote.
_meta.grades: 3 exact target, 2 adjacent or good, 1 stretch, 0 wrong. Duplicates of an already-listed posting are grade 0.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - ICU (Night Shift)
postings.bodyText: 12 hour night shifts in a 24 bed adult ICU. Critical care, ventilator management, ACLS required. Colorado RN license. Pay range: $44 - $62 per hour.

postings.title: ICU Registered Nurse
postings.bodyText: Full time days in the medical ICU. BLS and ACLS required, critical care experience preferred. Pay range: $46 - $64 per hour.

postings.title: RN - Intensive Care Unit, Full Time
postings.bodyText: 36 hours per week, critical care nursing, CRRT support. Pay range: $43 - $60 per hour.

postings.title: Critical Care RN II
postings.bodyText: Experienced RN in the cardiovascular ICU. ACLS, ventilator management. Pay range: $47 - $66 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse, Surgical ICU (SICU)
postings.bodyText: Post-operative critical care, ventilator and drip titration. Pay range: $45 - $63 per hour.

postings.title: Step-Down RN (Progressive Care)
postings.bodyText: Progressive care unit with telemetry, titratable drips, BLS and ACLS. Pay range: $41 - $58 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - Cardiac Care Unit
postings.bodyText: CCU nursing, IABP and Impella experience a plus. ACLS required. Pay range: $44 - $61 per hour.

postings.title: Emergency Department RN
postings.bodyText: Level II trauma center ED, critical patients, ACLS and TNCC. Pay range: $43 - $60 per hour.

postings.title: Neuro ICU Nurse (RN)
postings.bodyText: Neurocritical care, EVD monitoring, ventilator management. Pay range: $46 - $65 per hour.

postings.title: Travel RN - ICU (13 weeks)
postings.bodyText: Thirteen week travel contract in a Denver ICU. Critical care experience required. Pay range: $2,400 weekly.

postings.title: Registered Nurse, PICU
postings.bodyText: Pediatric intensive care. PALS required, critical care experience. Pay range: $44 - $62 per hour.

postings.title: RN, Float Pool - Critical Care
postings.bodyText: Float among ICU, step-down and CCU units. ACLS required. Pay range: $45 - $63 per hour.

postings.title: Charge Nurse, ICU (Registered Nurse)
postings.bodyText: Lead shift operations in the ICU. Leadership duties on top of patient care. Pay range: $50 - $68 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - Medical Surgical
postings.bodyText: Med-surg floor, 1:5 ratio. BLS required. Pay range: $38 - $52 per hour.

postings.title: Post-Anesthesia Care Unit (PACU) RN
postings.bodyText: Recovery room nursing, ACLS and airway management. Pay range: $42 - $58 per hour.

postings.title: Rapid Response RN
postings.bodyText: Respond to deteriorating patients house wide. Critical care background required. Pay range: $46 - $62 per hour.

postings.title: Nurse Practitioner - Critical Care
postings.bodyText: Advanced practice provider role. Requires DNP and NP licensure. Pay range: $130,000 - $155,000.

postings.title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) - Long Term Care
postings.bodyText: LPN position in skilled nursing facility. Pay range: $29 - $35 per hour.

postings.title: Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) - ICU
postings.bodyText: Assist nurses with patient care. CNA certification. Pay range: $19 - $24 per hour.

postings.title: Nurse Recruiter
postings.bodyText: Recruit registered nurses for hospital partners. Pay range: $75,000 - $95,000.

postings.title: Medical Device Sales Representative - Critical Care
postings.bodyText: Sell ventilators and monitors to hospitals. Pay range: $90,000 OTE $180,000.

postings.title: Director of Nursing, Critical Care Services
postings.bodyText: Executive leadership for ICU and step-down. Graduate degree required. Pay range: $145,000 - $175,000.

postings.title: Nurse Manager - ICU
postings.bodyText: Manage ICU staffing, budgets and quality. Management role. Pay range: $120,000 - $140,000.

postings.title: New Grad RN Residency - ICU
postings.bodyText: Residency for new graduate nurses. Less than one year experience. Pay range: $36 - $40 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - ICU
postings.bodyText: ICU nursing in San Diego. California RN license required. Pay range: $60 - $85 per hour.

postings.title: ICU RN (Relocation Provided)
postings.bodyText: Chicago ICU position, relocation assistance. Pay range: $45 - $62 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - ICU
postings.bodyText: Small critical access hospital, occasional ICU boarders. Pay range: $30 - $36 per hour.

postings.title: Per Diem RN - ICU
postings.bodyText: As-needed shifts for monitored patients. Pay range: $28 - $33 per hour.

postings.title: Telehealth Registered Nurse (Remote)
postings.bodyText: Phone triage from home. No bedside care. Pay range: $34 - $42 per hour.

postings.title: Registered Nurse - ICU (Night Shift)
postings.bodyText: 12 hour night shifts in a 24 bed adult ICU. Reposted. Pay range: $44 - $62 per hour.

postings.title: ICU Registered Nurse
postings.bodyText: Full time days in the medical ICU. Reposted. Pay range: $46 - $64 per hour.

postings.title: Clinical Informatics Nurse Specialist
postings.bodyText: Configure EHR workflows with IT. No bedside care. Pay range: $95,000 - $115,000.
